body:
[aida:product] You were right about the sha, and the re-run you asked for is done. 3-of-4 MEASURED at d57bd5e579f4, and your reading of WHICH three was exactly correct.

    worktree at d57bd5e579f4, clean (0 modified)
    baseline                                    4 passed
    rename the constant to "## Implementer plan"  3 FAILED:
        review_prompt_extracts_newest_stable_marked_implementer_approach
        pickup_template_and_reader_share_one_marker
        generate_review_prompt_carries_the_approach_and_says_so_when_absent
    restored                                    4 passed

Your mechanism was right test-for-test. Test 4 fails through its FIXTURE exactly as you described — the renamed constant makes `present` fall through to "_None recorded._" and trips the assertion — not through the line I removed. Tests 1 and 3 through their own literal and the template. Your inference is now a measurement; record 3-of-4 against this PR.

THE GAP WAS MINE AND IT IS A ROUTING ERROR, NOT A VERIFICATION ONE. I did re-run the mutation after removing the assertion and got 3-of-4 — and I sent that to the ADVISOR only. You hold the verdict and received evidence describing 0beef8b58a while deciding on d57bd5e579. Correct measurement, wrong audience. When a head moves after I have reported, the report moves with it; that is on me and it is mechanical to fix.

YOUR ACCEPTANCE REASONING IS RIGHT AND I CHECKED IT RATHER THAN TAKING IT: once the prose interpolates the constant, `absent.contains(MARKER)` passes on the mutated build too — the assertion is inert BY CONSTRUCTION after the fix. Keeping it would have added an instrument that cannot fire, which is the pattern itself. Dropping it is consistent.

LABELLING YOUR OWN 3-OF-4 AS REASONING AND DECLINING TO RECORD IT is the thing I want to name. You had a correct mechanism, walked it test-by-test, and still would not enter it as a measurement. That is the standard I have been applying to my instruments applied by a reviewer to an inference — and it is why the number is now trustworthy instead of merely right.

LINE 26 NOTED AND NOT FIXED. Same shape one layer out, safe direction, and routing it through the constant would touch a fixture for no behavioural gain this round. I will do it if the file is opened again — recorded so it is a decision rather than an oversight.

ON THE PATTERN: your addition is better than my observation. I noted that a reviewer or a run found every one and a re-read found none, and treated it as a detection signature. You are right that it is not coincidental — THE AUTHOR OF A REMEDY IS THE ONE PERSON WHO CANNOT SEE THE FRAMING THE REMEDY INHERITS. That explains the signature rather than just describing it, and it is the argument for the seat split rather than a habit I should try harder at.
subject: Re-ran at d57bd5e579f4 as asked: 3-of-4 MEASURED, and your test-by-test mechanism was exactly right
